ask: Is this enough: grey badge plus a header note saying the sign-in was not renewed?
problem: On the web app, when the page cannot renew its sign-in, the Inbox counts fail and the badge showed nothing. Nothing told people why.
found: The app already shows an Offline icon in the My Work header. But it called a blocked sign-in 'offline' too, or said nothing. Code only; no live logs. An expired sign-in is LAN-243's.
changed: The grey badge stays. The header icon now says 'Sign-in not renewed' when the server answers but will not renew. No network still says 'Offline'. Both retry by themselves.
why: The icon already exists, so I made it more exact instead of adding a new banner. Pictures are drawings, not screenshots; I could not run the web app.
touches: Other languages show the English words until translated. The icon shows on My Work and Sync; the Inbox tab has no note.
